Punjab PCS Prelims Result 2026 Out: The Punjab Public Service Commission declared the PPSC PCS Result 2025 on 10th January 2026. This is the result for the Punjab Civil Services Prelims Exam 2025, which was held on 7th December 2025. Based on the result, the candidates have been shortlisted for the Mains Exam.  The Punjab Civil Services Exam is being conducted for recruitment for 322 vacancies. The final selection will be based on the scores of the Mains Exam and Interview. Aspirants can check the Punjab PCS Result release date, download link, and other details from this post.

Punjab PCS Prelims Result 2026 Out @ppsc.gov.in

The Punjab PCS Result for the Prelims 2025 was announced @ppsc.gov.in. The result is available in the form of a PDF containing the roll number-wise list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the Mains Exam. Along with the result, the cut-off marks and final answer key have also been released. If you had appeared for the exam, you can visit the commission’s official website or use the direct link in this article to check your PPSC PCS Result 2025.

Punjab PCS Prelims Result 2025-26
Exam Name Punjab Civil Services
Exam Conducting Body Punjab Public Service Commission
Official Website ppsc.gov.in
Exam Stages Prelims, Mains, Interview
Prelims Date 7th December 2025
PPSC PCS Prelims Result Date 10th January 2026

Punjab PCS Result 2025 Download Link

The Punjab PCS Prelims Result 2025 is announced on the commission’s official website. Candidates who appeared for the exam can now visit @ppsc.gov.in and download the roll number-wise list of candidates shortlisted for the Mains Exam.  You can also use the direct link given below to check the results.

Download Punjab PCS Prelims Result 2025 PDF

How to Download PPSC PCS Prelims Result 2026?

You can easily download the Punjab PCS Result 2025-26 from the commission’s official website. The result is available on the website as a PDF containing the roll number-wise list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the Mains. To check the result, follow the steps mentioned below.

Step 1. Go to the official website @ppsc.gov.in.

Step 2. Under the ‘Announcements’ section, click the Punjab PCS Prelims Result PDF.

Step 3. The result will appear on your screen.

Step 4. Download and save the PDF to your device for reference.

What are the Details Mentioned on the Punjab PCS Prelims Result 2026?

The Punjab Civil Services Result for the Prelims contains the list of candidates who have been shortlisted for the Mains Exam. It also contains other details which one must check carefully to avoid discrepancies later. These details include:

  • Name and stage of the Exam
  • Exam Date
  • Roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
  • Cut off marks
  • Instructions for the Mains.
